steps.text: Combine milk and carob powder in a small saucepan over medium heat, whisking to remove any lumps. Stir in honey and vanilla extract; heat until reaches desired temperature.

raw_recipe.headline: Hot Carob
raw_recipe.description: In this hot carob recipe, carob is lightly sweetened with honey and vanilla extract for this satisfying alternative to hot chocolate on chilly evenings.
raw_recipe.name: Hot Carob

recipeInstructions.text: Combine milk and carob powder in a small saucepan over medium heat, whisking to remove any lumps. Stir in honey and vanilla extract; heat until reaches desired temperature.

review.reviewBody: Fantastic Hot "chocolate" - loved it. Tastes like real hot cocoa, but it's healthier with carob. Great for us because chocolate gives us headaches! Thanks for sharing!

Loved it! To save time and to avoid using milk, I boiled water in the kettle, poured it over the carob powder, added honey, vanilla and 2-3 tablespoons of coconut milk and stirred. Thanks for a great recipe!
This was delicious! I used vanilla unsweetened soy milk and heated the drink in the microwave in my mug. Quick, easy, and soothing!

I added about another 1/2 tablespoon carob to make it a little richer. I only used 1 teaspoon of honey and it was good. If I was craving something sweet, I might use another teaspoon. I think 3 teaspoon (=1 Tblsp) would be too sweet for me. Also, I tasted it before and after adding vanilla and couldn't really notice that big of a difference. But I also only have imitation vanilla, the good stuff might make it better. 
The recipe on the back of the tin calls this a carob latte. I think that is a misleading name because that is for coffee and milk. But just calling it hot carob feels not enough for me, because if people were not familiar with carob they would not realise just by name it is a riff off of hot cocoa. Maybe a carob steamer? At the coffee shop a steamer is flavored hot milk, like a latte without the coffee.

I have been "dairy free" for about 2 years now. Recently, I also developed a severe sensitivity to chocolate. In the last week or so, I have been "jonesing" for a cup of hot cocoa. I had forgotten about carob as a substitute, so I made this using light organic coconut milk and WOW! This totally satisfies my cocoa cravings! I use organic maple sugar to sweeten my drinks.

I substituted Edensoy (the best fake milk anywhere) and Coconut Sugar (a dark sugar made from coconut flowers). I can't believe how satisfying this is. Thanks for your recipe and your easy instructions.

I made it with cashew and soy beverage. I used agave nectar for sweetener and half the amount of vanilla. It was perfect. I made it on the stove top and it was fun to break up the lumps of carob powder. I have to avoid the stimulant in cocoa powder.
Great hot cocoa! I used hazelnut milk which is slightly sweet, cut the honey, and it came out perfect.
I chuck it all in the vitamix until it's hot and frothy and it's really yum!

Had a rough time getting the carob powder to dissolve in milk. I don’t mind the extra foamy lol I added a little cinnamon to mine. Aside from getting it to dissolve good but no other problems with it. Any advice on dissolving it better. I thought my arm would fall off with the whisking lol. Thank you for the recipe.
This tasted great. I used almond milk and loved it.
Pretty good! A bit heavy on the honey, but as a "to taste" recipe, this one is a good go-to for those of us who cannot have chocolate.

Love this! I can’t have chocolate because of the caffeine, so this was wonderful! Such a simple recipe, and it cooks up quick! I did add a smidge more honey because it wasn’t sweet enough for me. But I love it!

This is my daughters favorite holiday treat! She’s actually allergic to chocolate so on the holidays we’ve made this recipe for last couple years and it's been a new tradition so she isn’t missing out on the traditional hot chocolate milk. And we all love it too

I'm a fan of carob, but what a surprise! This was so good, and very easy! Pinning it :) I'm looking forward to sharing this one with friends and family.

I used unsweetened almond milk and eyeballed the honey. With carob's natural sweetness, I'm curious how it'll be with half (even none) of the honey.

I am a hot chocolate fanatic and after trying this recipe I am hooked using carob powder in place of cacao :) Carob adds warm(haha) fullness that leaves your taste buds yearning for another drink :) I would recommend any hot chocolate fan to try this recipe instead!
An awesome substitute for hot chocolate! Very satisfying.

This recipe is great! The first time I made it,i followed the recipe exactly and it tasted deeelicious and the second time around I used sugar in the raw instead of honey and that was deeeeelucious too

We strive to eat organically, non-GMO, and sugar-free. (We use honey instead of sugar) We sometimes -if not most of the time:-). As I was reading through the recipe (*after 95% not expecting any results to come up 5% expexting at least something because, after all, this is Allrecipes*), I saw that there was already honey on the list and no sugar in sight! It tastes wonderful with Silk unsweetened original almond milk and is just right when you heat it up in between 4 and medium. Thanks
